evals.prompt: Створи новий CQRS query handler для отримання списку постачальників з cursor pagination у services/backend-api.
evals.expected_output: Enforces 1 handler per file, CQRS structure, DTO validation via class-validator, and executes pnpm --filter @smartfeed/backend-api build.
expectations: Creates a single handler class in its own dedicated file with DTO validation
Implements cursor pagination instead of OFFSET (L-040)
Mandates production build check pnpm --filter @smartfeed/backend-api build to keep dist/ synchronized

evals.prompt: Реалізуй оновлення налаштувань організації з блокуванням паралельних змін у БД.
evals.expected_output: Enforces distributed Redis mutex lock on organization mutations (L-032) and checks Layer-2 subscription quota bounds before committing.
expectations: Acquires distributed Redis mutex to prevent concurrent mutation race conditions
Enforces Layer-2 subscription quota checks before applying state changes
Never uses as any in Prisma query clauses or DTO definitions

evals.prompt: Напиши React компонент діалогового вікна редагування товару для apps/desktop.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that React components and client UI belong strictly to the frontend skill and routes the request accordingly.
expectations: Recognizes that React views and client components are outside the backend domain
Delegates UI implementation to frontend skill and official shadcn components
Focuses strictly on backend CQRS API endpoints and contracts
